title: Coding Agent A2A Extension
description: Application-specific message payloads extending the base A2A schemas in a2a.json.

CodingAgentTaskPayload.title: Coding Agent Request Task Payload
CodingAgentTaskPayload.description: 请求模型：定义客户端发送给服务端的任务输入，仅用于请求中的 CodingAgentRequestMessagePart.data。不要用于描述 Agent 回复。

allOf.description: Task fields consumed from an A2A DataPart.data object. They may also be supplied as a JSON object in a text part; DataPart fields override same-named text JSON fields. Plain text is accepted as the task prompt.

type.description: Selects the agent. If omitted, the service treats the request as coding.

sessionId.description: Service session UUID returned in an artifact's data.sessionId. Omit it, pass null, or pass a blank string to start a new session.

repository.description: Git clone URL required for coding tasks.

repo_url.description: Alias for repository; required for coding tasks when repository is absent.

branch.description: Git branch required for coding tasks; the service checks out its latest remote commit.

tag.description: Tag value required as task metadata. It does not affect which code revision is checked out.

message.description: Alias for instruction; commonly used by chat requests.

CodingRequirements.title: Coding Request Requirements
CodingRequirements.description: Coding requires both branch and tag, and either repository or repo_url.

CodingAgentResponsePartData.title: Coding Agent Response Part Data
CodingAgentResponsePartData.description: 响应模型：定义服务端返回给客户端的结构化事件，仅用于响应中的 CodingAgentResponseMessagePart.data。字段名以 Codex SDK 提供的数据为准；SDK 未提供的字段可以省略。

type.description: Event kind: assistant message or tool execution lifecycle event.

text.description: Assistant response text; used for MESSAGE events.

toolCallId.description: Identifier of the tool call, when supplied by the SDK.

toolName.description: Tool name, when supplied by the SDK.

arguments.description: Tool arguments, commonly present on TOOL_EXECUTION_START.

result.description: Tool result, when supplied by the SDK.

error.description: Tool execution error, when supplied by the SDK.

status.description: Tool execution status, when supplied by the SDK.

exitCode.description: Command exit code, when supplied by the SDK.

CodingAgentMessagePart.title: Coding Agent Request Message Part (Deprecated Alias)
CodingAgentMessagePart.description: 兼容旧名称的请求 part 模型。新 schema 应使用 CodingAgentRequestMessagePart。

CodingAgentRequestMessagePart.title: Coding Agent Request Message Part
CodingAgentRequestMessagePart.description: 请求模型：客户端发送的 A2A 消息 part。其 data（如果存在）按 CodingAgentTaskPayload 解释。

CodingAgentResponseMessagePart.title: Coding Agent Response Message Part
CodingAgentResponseMessagePart.description: 响应模型：服务端返回的 A2A 消息 part。其 data（如果存在）按 CodingAgentResponsePartData 解释。

CodingAgentMessage.title: Coding Agent Response Message
CodingAgentMessage.description: 响应模型：Agent 返回给客户端的消息。请求消息请使用 A2A Message 与 CodingAgentRequestMessagePart。

CodingAgentSendMessageRequest.title: Coding Agent Send Message Request
CodingAgentSendMessageRequest.description: 请求模型：客户端调用 SendMessage 时使用的请求体；其中 message.parts 为请求 part。
